caption.text: A payoff plan from your own balances, rates and minimum payments: the month you are debt-free, the order the debts clear, and what the cheaper method saves. A debt with no rate is named as left out, never guessed at.

reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index": an index of tabs, so scenes slide in like the next tab.
Camera "locked": still and precise, so a slow, reading audience is never chasing the frame.
Grounds ink → light → light → accent: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Most of this audience never unmutes, so nothing depends on sound; cues are kept quieter and sparser for those who do.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on Pinterest video pin (0.32s a word), inside 10–32s.
